name: shine-border

frames.best_why: The coloured glow is at its most even, wrapping all four edges and corners of the card.

tagline: A purple-pink glow travels around the edge of a dark card.
summary: A thin animated border of gradient light that sweeps around a card's outline, here wrapping a login form in shifting lilac, pink and peach.
appearance: A dark rounded login card with a heading, two outlined inputs and a light Sign in button. Around its perimeter runs a soft line of purple, pink and warm orange light, brightest near the corners and fading along the edges.
behaviour: The light band travels steadily around the border, gliding through the corners and completing laps without a pause. The card content itself stays still.
demo_content: A login card with Email and Password fields and a Sign in button.
use_when: A card needs to stand out with a moving coloured edge without recolouring its contents.
avoid_when: Light backgrounds or many cards; the glow is subtle and the loop repeats forever.
customise: Set borderWidth, duration and shineColor (one colour or an array); it is an overlay, so content and rounded corners come from the parent card.
weight_why: A single absolutely positioned gradient layer animated by one CSS keyframe.

a11y.note: It is a decorative overlay that already stops animating when reduced-motion is requested.

polish_why: A smooth, restrained gradient glow; it relies on a dark card to read well.
